fact: 1907年9月30日， Henri Farman驾驶定制的Voisin-Farman I双翼机完成其首次飞行，航程约100英尺（30米），标志其从航空爱好者向职业飞行家的转变；该机由巴黎近郊的Voisin兄弟作坊体系供给。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Wright Brothers: 1907-08
sources.quote: He began to fly with a customized Voison-Farman I plane on September 30, 1907, flying just 100 feet (30 meters). He modified the plane and began to fly a little farther.

fact: 1907年10月26日，Henri Farman飞行2350英尺（712米），赢得第二届Archdeacon Cup（年度最长飞行奖），成为欧洲航空竞赛体系中的首位重要法国获奖者之一。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Wright Brothers: 1907-08
sources.quote: On October 26, 1907, Farman flew 2,350 feet (712 meters) and won the second Archdeacon Cup for making the longest flight during the year.

fact: 1908年1月13日，Farman以完成一公里闭合航线飞行赢得Grand Prix de Aviation大奖及5万法郎奖金（约1万美元），证明1907年底积累的飞行小时可直接转化为现金奖励与声誉资本。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Wright Brothers: 1907-08
sources.quote: On January 13, 1908, he won the Grand Prix de Aviation and its 50,000-franc purse by flying a one-kilometer (0.6-mile) circular course.

fact: 1907年夏，Louis Blériot制造的串联翼Blériot VI Libellule（蜻蜓）在巴黎近郊Issy-les-Moulineaux完成数次短距跳跃，高度均低于40英尺（12米）；此前他已于1906年结束与Gabriel Voisin的合作，转向自己设计的单翼机路线。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Louis Blériot (Aerospace essay)
sources.quote: the same year, he built the tandem-wing Blériot VI Libellule (Dragonfly), which made several short hops at Issy-les-Moulineaux, near Paris, during the summer of 1907—all at an altitude of less than 40 feet (12 meters).

fact: Blériot VII于1907年问世：采用低置悬臂翼、封闭机身、方向尾，并首次组合使用升降舵与副翼；1907年11—12月在Issy试飞共6次，其中2次飞行超过1640英尺（500米），时速约50英里（80公里/小时），Enclosed Antoinette发动机直接驱动四叶金属 tractor 螺旋桨。该机型确立了欧洲单翼机发展的基本方向。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Louis Blériot (Aerospace essay)
sources.quote: His Blériot VII appeared in 1907. It marked a milestone for flight performance and aerodynamics. ... The plane was tested in November and December 1907 at Issy, and made a total of six flights. In two flights, the plane covered more than 1,640 feet (500 meters) at a speed of about 50 miles per hour (80 kilometers per hour).

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Blériot's 1909 Channel Flight (Explorers essay)
sources.quote: Then, in 1907 at Bagatelle, France, he flew a plane he had designed himself, the Bleriot Model VII, for the first time, flying more than 1,640 feet (500 meters). Although the craft itself was not considered a success, the Model VII set the pattern for much of Europe's monoplane development.

fact: 作为1907年法国航空热潮的前史：居住巴黎的巴西人Alberto Santos-Dumont于1906年10月驾驶14-bis完成欧洲第一架经官方认可的重于空气飞行；此后Farman、Blériot、Esnault-Pelterie等人在法国形成密集的飞行-竞赛-制造网络。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — The Beginnings of French Commercial Aviation
sources.quote: The first officially recognized heavier-than-air flight in Europe took place in October 1906, when Alberto Santos-Dumont flew his 14-bis plane. ... France was one of the most active pioneers in heavier-than-air flight in Europe. ... Pioneers such as Henri Farman, Louis Blériot, and Robert Esnault-Pelterie followed in his footsteps.

fact: 1908年8月8日，Wilbur Wright在法国Le Mans当着Blériot与航空赞助人Ernest Archdeacon等人面完成完美飞行，彻底扭转法国舆论对莱特兄弟的嘲讽；Blériot当场感叹“Monsieur Wright has us all in his hands”，显示1907—08年之交法美航空技术竞争的舆论转折。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Wright Brothers: 1907-08
sources.quote: On August 8, 1908, the weather cleared. In front of small crowd that included the aviator Louis Blériot and aviation backer Ernest Archdeacon, he made a brief but perfect flight that astounded his audience. ... Blériot exclaimed: “I would have waited ten times as long to see what I have seen today….Monsieur Wright has us all in his hands.”

fact: 莱特兄弟与法国资本集团Compagnie Générale de Navigation Aérienne签署制造销售合同：提供4架双座飞机、完成4次载客50公里示范飞行并教会3人单飞；报价每架2万法郎（约4000美元），并因示范机获得50万法郎现金（约10万美元）及该法国公司半数股权。显示法国航空市场已出现“资本集团+专利特许”的组织形式。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Wright Brothers: 1907-08
sources.quote: The Wrights had finally signed a contract with a French business group that had formed La Compagnie Generale de Navigation Aerienne to manufacture and sell Wright aircraft in France. The Wrights would provide four airplanes that could seat two people, carry out four demonstration flights of 31 miles (50 kilometers) each while carrying a passenger, and teach three men to fly and solo. The Wrights quoted a price of 20,000 francs (about $4,000) each and also received 500,000 francs (about $100,000) cash for the demonstration aircraft and half-ownership in the French company.

fact: 1909年8月兰斯航空周（La Grande Semaine d'Aviation de la Champagne）由当地葡萄种植者与市政官员于春季筹资创办：Farman赢得最富有的里程赛冠军（5万法郎，约1万美元），全程180公里用时3小时4分56秒，全周奖金合计6.3万法郎（逾1.2万美元），为该周最大赢家。航空奖金经济在1907—09年间成型。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — The Reims Air Meet of 1909 (Explorers essay)
sources.quote: Local French vintners and Reims city officials founded the Reims Air Meet in the spring of 1909 when they agreed to raise prize money and sponsor the air show. ... Farman thrilled his fellow citizens by winning the distance contest, the richest cash prize of the meet at 50,000 francs or approximately $10,000. He captured the event by covering 180 kilometers (112 miles) in a plane of his own design in 3 hours, 4 minutes, and 56 seconds. ... All told, Farman collected 63,000 francs, or more than $12,000, in prizes during the week and became the meet’s biggest money winner.

fact: Farman的企业化路径有明确历史结果：战后初期，1919年2月8日一组法国商人改装Farman公司双发Goliath biplane开辟伦敦—巴黎海峡航线；至1919年8月，Farman已提供该航线每日客运服务，每班最多14名乘客。早期私营航线因成本高、票价高、客源不足而难以为继，后依赖国家支持。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — The Beginnings of French Commercial Aviation
sources.quote: Near the end of the war, on February 8, 1919, a group of French businessmen had remodeled the Farman Company’s twin-engine Goliath biplane and began flying routes across the English Channel between Paris and London. By August 1919, Farman was offering daily service on this route for as many as 14 passengers. ... The early burgeoning private services, however, proved not to be financially viable because of high operating costs, high fares, and low passenger turnout.

fact: 法国批发与零售价格在1907年明显背离：据美国劳工局第284号公报转载的法国总统计局（Statistique générale de la France）10种商品指数（1891-1900=100），1907年批发/进口价指数为115、零售价指数为95（1906年分别为109与95，1908年为122与99，1909年批发122）。即1907年批发端同比上涨约5.5%而零售端持平，1908年批发继续上涨后零售才跟涨约4%；1906年起该批发指数改按国内市场上12个月报价均值计算。

fact: 法国另两条独立价格序列（同见BLS第284号公报）：La Réforme Économique批发指数（1890=100）1906年105.4、1907年112.2、1908年回落至101.2；Levasseur对巴黎及近郊70所中学合同采购的20种食品与煤炭指数（1895&1900=100）巴黎1907年为98、1908年99，法国合计1907年103、1908年107——巴黎机构合同食品价1907年基本持平、1908年才明显上升。注意：Réforme序列1908年回落与法国总统计局10种商品批发指数1908年续涨（122）方向相反，系商品篮子与计价口径不同，两序列并列保存不强行调和。
